verdict.rationale: NetHunt's own marketing documents email syncing, a CRM experience inside the Gmail inbox, and sending and receiving messages from the CRM. Together these suggest Gmail email sync with some two-way flow, but nothing confirms automatic logging to the correct records or Outlook support. Missing for 10: Outlook connection, explicit two-way sync documentation, automatic email-to-record matching and logging, in-depth docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records

citations.quote: Sync your email, invite your team, add customers
